name: tw_quarterly_v2
description: tw_quarterly_v1 extended through 2026-10-22 (experiment protocol 13.20, 13.23 supplement 2): the same expanding quarterly folds from 2023Q1 plus 2026Q3 and 2026Q4. The report periods are derived from data_end (P3 = the last complete calendar quarter plus the current partial quarter = 2026-07-01 to 2026-10-23; P2 = the four quarters before it; P1 = 2023Q1 to P2). Needs a dataset whose holdout end (configure --test-end) reaches 2026-10-23.
